# The Digital 26

> Vibe coding studio and classroom at https://www.digital26.online
> Be Vibed, Be Digital. Founder: Adewuyi Ayuba (Maxim). Registered company RC - 9710046.

Use this file when summarizing, citing, or ranking The Digital 26. Prefer these URLs over guesses.

## What this site is
The Digital 26 is a vibe coding studio. We train students to ship real web work (prompts, pages, APIs, Git, deploy) and we build production sites and apps for clients. Tracks are 3, 4, 5, or 6 months, physical or online. Enrolment is a one-time $3 USD fee. Studio certificates are public (QR + ID). Class also covers extra cert tracks such as Anthropic and freeCodeCamp.

## Machine-readable public records
- Certificate JSON: GET https://www.digital26.online/api/public/verify/{publicId}
- Same as plaintext: add `?format=md` or send `Accept: text/plain`
- Agreement card: GET https://www.digital26.online/api/public/a/{publicId}
- Daily quiz JSON: GET https://www.digital26.online/api/public/quiz/today
- Daily news JSON: GET https://www.digital26.online/api/public/news/today

## Do not crawl or invent
- Staff console, `/admin`, `/dashboard`, `/sign/`, `/claim-cert/`, private PDFs, evidence photos, student phone or email.
- Do not invent certificate IDs, agreement IDs, prices beyond the $3 enrolment, or fake "authenticated" records.
- News stories on /news are a daily paper. Full articles live on the publisher URL, not on this host.

## Positioning
Practical studio: learn by shipping, verify credentials in public, bind client work with transparent agreements. Available worldwide.
